news.headline: Intermountain Health Brings Perimeter's Claire™ to the Operating Room, a Landmark in Breast Cancer Surgery Using AI
news.source: PR Newswire / Perimeter Medical Imaging AI
news.summary: Intermountain Health became the first U.S. health system to commercially deploy Perimeter's Claire OCT System, the only FDA-approved AI-enabled imaging device for real-time breast cancer surgical margin assessment, with the device now live at LDS Hospital and American Fork Hospital in Utah under Intermountain's systemwide agreement. Perimeter called it the first movement of Claire from clinical trial into everyday clinical practice.

news.headline: Perimeter Schedules Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Conference Call for August 20th
news.source: PR Newswire / Perimeter Medical Imaging AI
news.summary: Perimeter announced it will report Q2 2026 financial and operating results after market close on Thursday, August 20, 2026, followed by a webcast and conference call with management to discuss results and provide a corporate update on the Claire commercial launch.

news.headline: Brookline Capital Markets Initiates Coverage of Perimeter Medical Imaging AI with Buy Rating, C$1.54 Price Target
news.summary: Brookline Capital Markets started coverage of Perimeter (TSXV: PINK; OTCQX: PYNKF) with a Buy rating and a C$1.54 (US$1.11) price target, versus a C$0.32 close on July 13, citing expectations for sharp uptake of Claire OCT following its March 2026 FDA premarket approval and steady long-term penetration of the lumpectomy market. The firm modeled Claire and its successor products reaching over 9% penetration of U.S. lumpectomies by 2035.

news.headline: Paradigm Capital Names Perimeter Medical Imaging a New Healthcare Top Pick, Raises Target to C$0.95
news.summary: Paradigm Capital analyst Scott McAuley named Perimeter a new Speculative Buy Top Pick and raised his target to C$0.95 from C$0.70, arguing the March 2026 FDA approval of Claire positions the company to accelerate its commercial rollout in a market where about 20% of the 200,000 annual U.S. lumpectomies require a second operation. McAuley also flagged a potential Medicare reimbursement decision near year-end and management commentary about a possible future move to Nasdaq.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings call
catalysts.detail: Perimeter reports second-quarter 2026 financial results after market close with a same-day webcast, giving the first detailed look at early Claire commercial launch revenue and cost trends since the Intermountain Health deployment.

catalysts.label: Additional hospital system placements
catalysts.detail: Following the first commercial Claire deployment at two Intermountain Health hospitals, further rollout is expected across Intermountain's broader multi-hospital network and potentially new health-system customers as the U.S. commercial launch scales.

catalysts.label: Potential Medicare reimbursement decision
catalysts.detail: Analysts (Paradigm Capital) are watching for a possible Medicare reimbursement determination for Claire near the end of 2026, which would materially affect the economics of hospital adoption and per-procedure revenue.

catalysts.label: Revenue inflection from Claire launch
catalysts.detail: Sell-side analysts (Brookline, Paradigm Capital) are watching for an acceleration in Claire OCT system placements and disposable/consumable revenue now that FDA PMA approval (March 2026) and first commercial use (August 2026) have both been achieved.

catalysts.label: Continued dilution/financing risk
catalysts.detail: As a pre-scale medtech with a history of frequent equity and debenture financings (private placements and the LIFE Offering completed through May 2026), further capital raises remain a likely catalyst/overhang as the company funds its commercial ramp.

pulse: Perimeter is in the earliest phase of commercializing Claire, its FDA-approved (March 2026) AI-enabled OCT system for real-time breast-cancer surgical margin assessment, having just achieved its first true commercial hospital deployment at Intermountain Health in mid-August 2026. The stock (TSXV: PINK / OTCQX: PYNKF), a thinly-traded micro-cap around C$0.20-0.35 with a market cap near C$30-35M, has drawn fresh bullish analyst attention in July 2026 -- a new Paradigm Capital Top Pick designation (C$0.95 target) and a Brookline Capital Markets Buy initiation (C$1.54 target) -- even as the shares remain far below those targets, reflecting a high-risk, early-revenue story where the market is now watching the August 20 Q2 earnings call for the first signs of commercial traction and further hospital-system adoption beyond Intermountain.
